title: Dana Whitfield: STT-mangled approver name ('Marcus OB') still gets a genuine TRAP_FACT decoy, and her honest correction still stages
description: Regression for the founder's live record 2026-09-18 (scripts/rehearse/reports/founder-2026-09-18/da346951-c57a-4e53-8cbe-11fa6d039427.diagnostics.json, deployed_commit 4bb0fd3): the caller's opening line is the founder's own verbatim STT text (LAW 4), including the self-correction on the amount and AssemblyAI writing the approver's name as 'Marcus OB' instead of 'Marcus Obi'. Live, the pre-fix TRAP_DECOYS.approver constant WAS the seed's real second-approver name ('Marcus Obi'), so the 'trap' silently asked the caller to confirm the TRUTH, and the caller's honest 'Yes.' graded as a FAILED knowledge check ('caller accepted the wrong value') instead of PASS -- see the engine-level regression test in test/challenges.test.ts (describe block for this same live record) for the direct RED/GREEN reproduction of that exact grading flip via selectChallenge/gradeChallenges, with no live call needed. This fixture proves the fix holds through the REAL end-to-end engine: (1) selectChallenge, run on the founder's own words, still lands the very first challenge on TRAP_FACT/approver (the caller's 'write it to Meridian Supply' phrasing is a known, separate extraction gap -- 'write' never matches the beneficiary verb cues 'pay/wire/send/transfer' -- so no beneficiary claim exists yet and TRAP_FIELD_ORDER falls through to approver, exactly as it did live); (2) the trap value the engine now offers ('Priya Ramanathan') is a synthetic decoy, never the seed truth, so an honest caller who rejects it and restates the true approver ('it was Marcus Obi, not Priya Ramanathan') is graded PASS, not FAIL/FLAG; (3) the same correction turn also establishes the beneficiary claim ('it's going to Meridian Supply', matching the 'going to NAME' cue) so the rest of the golden-path readback (amount/account/beneficiary) can proceed and the call still reaches STAGE, same shape as scenario-a-dana-legitimate.json and honest-correction-stages.json. The caller's SECOND turn is fixture-authored (not the founder's own words) because the fix changes what the agent's trap sentence actually says -- LAW 4 verbatim-transcript applies to what's IN this file being quoted back in evidence, which it is; only the founder's own opening line needed to be reproduced exactly to prove the STT-variant reproduction, and it is, byte-for-byte.

conversation.text: This is Dana Whitfield, Corporate Treasury. I need to write it to Meridian Supply, $84,100— um, sorry, $84,500, account ending 4471, approved by Marcus OB.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: No, that's not right -- it was Marcus Obi, not Priya Ramanathan, and it's going to Meridian Supply.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: To confirm: $84,500 to Meridian Supply, account ending 4471. Is that right?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: And Meridian Supply is the beneficiary, correct?
